entries.text: Saw the demo. Do you have ten minutes to explain it in four?
Could you send weekly retention? Monthly is fine if the month is bad.
Love the energy. What stops the large platform from adding it before lunch?
Circling back to circle back. The round is still open, then?
Not a fit for this fund. Please keep us updated on evidence that would make us regret this.
A customer used it twice without being reminded. That is a warmer introduction than mine.
97% chance of sun. The remaining 3% is currently covering the city.
Visibility improving in the model. Please continue looking through the windscreen.
A gentle breeze at sea level. Your slide deck has reached the next block.
Clear tonight, except where it is not. Forecast confidence remains excellent.
We adjusted yesterday’s forecast to match yesterday’s weather.
Fog at the next intersection. Conditions on this side remain commercially sunny.
Five stars. Waited for the crossing, apologised to a bollard, arrived on time.
Three stars. We passed my destination twice. The second pass was more confident.
Five stars. Asked once about the temperature and believed my answer.
Two stars. The ride included a pitch. I had already paid for the ride.
Four stars. Admitted it was lost, stopped safely and asked for help.
No rating. A cone has changed the strategic direction of this journey.
Your ride is stopped safely. Choose a new pickup point or end the ride.
Here is the trip estimate and the final fare. A route correction does not add a new booking fee.
The vehicle will wait until the hood is clear. Please do not stand in the road.
Your refund request is recorded. The reply will show the trip and amount before you confirm.
I can help with the route, fare, cancellation or a stopped vehicle.
Humbled to share that someone used the thing for the second time.
Grateful to announce more runway. The spreadsheet has become emotionally available.
A small milestone: fewer bad robots, same number of slides.
Learned a lot from today’s demo. Most of it involved the carpet.
Proud of the team for asking what the customer meant before writing the announcement.
No launch today. Fixed a bug. Surprisingly good day.
Know where the groceries are. Including when something went wrong.
One route your driver can finish.
Fewer meetings about the meeting tool.
Show the work. Keep the undo button.
A shorter queue is a measurable outcome.
Useful even when it says it does not know.
